name: Hai'an

routes.outcome: Official Hai'an government search result identifies the Hai'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and states that registration applications use cadastral survey forms, parcel maps, boundary-point coordinates or survey reports. This evidences a local registration procedure, not a public parcel-vector endpoint. Direct curl from this environment returned HTTP 403; the search result was not treated as geometry evidence.

Official Hai'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau notice describes 2025 city map revision and coordinated administrative/map data review. It is general map-production evidence; no parcel API or parcel geometry is exposed.
Official Hai'an government-service portal loaded anonymously. It exposes a service directory and links, but no parcel feature service or safe parcel geometry.

Official Jiangsu immovable-property registration directory loaded. The page links to registration service portals, including an external login URL; no anonymous parcel-vector response was obtained. Login was not attempted.
Official Tianditu·Jiangsu public map viewer loaded. Current HTML references /server/static/js/index.js?v=1.6.7 and generic map/thematic services; no Hai'an cadastral layer was exposed.

Current viewer JavaScript was inspected. It exposes generic TianDiTu WMTS basemaps and a provincial-boundaries ArcGIS REST tile/export layer, plus thematic-map links; no parcel, cadastral, immovable-property or Hai'an-specific vector service was identified.

The Jiangsu service-directory link points to an external immovable-property registration login route. Anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds; no retry with credentials, token, or bypass was attempted.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified for a Hai'an parcel source.

localCustodianAssessment: Hai'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is evidenced by official Hai'an government materials as the local natural-resources and registration custodian. The Hai'an government-service portal and Jiangsu immovable-property registration directory are official service routes. Tianditu·Jiangsu is a provincial public mapping node and was treated as a general map service, not as evidence of a Hai'an cadastral layer.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; a serial reviewer would need to independently qualify a real parcel source before runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.
No exact-point parcel hit or miss was used as a citywide absence claim.
The registration login route was not accessed with credentials.
The current Tianditu·Jiangsu HTML and JavaScript were inspected, but only generic basemap, boundary and thematic services were exposed.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: Local registration custody and cadastral procedure are evidenced, but anonymous parcel-service reachability, coverage, schema/CRS, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. HTTP 403 on the direct Hai'an government page and the external registration-login timeout are access limitations, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
